summary: An env-style module shebang such as #!/usr/bin/env <interpreter> is treated as one string including the space, so it won't work with interpreter substitution; shebang arguments are not supported.
questions: Why doesn't #!/usr/bin/env python3 work in my custom module?
Can I pass arguments in a module shebang?

answer_card.title: Avoid env shebangs in modules
answer_card.answer_md: `#!/usr/bin/env python3` in a module is read as a **single string** (`/usr/bin/env python3`), so interpreter substitution doesn't work. Shebang arguments aren't supported. Use `#!/usr/bin/python` and set `ansible_python_interpreter`.
